verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is a card-issuing platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt probe and the API docs are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
